definitions.explanation: The main point or underlying purpose of something; what is being aimed at or intended.

examples.japanese: {趣旨|しゅし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{趣旨|しゅし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't understand the purpose of this.

examples.japanese: {趣旨|しゅし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{趣旨|しゅし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To understand the purpose of the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{趣旨|しゅし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦しなければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: We must respond in line with the intent of the law.

notes:
{趣旨|しゅし} refers to the main point, purpose, or underlying intent of something. It's commonly used in formal and business contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {趣旨|しゅし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to explain the purpose
- {趣旨|しゅし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to understand the intent
- {趣旨|しゅし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}う→沿う：13279_sou⟧: to be in line with the intent
- {趣旨|しゅし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反|はん}する→反する：11966_hansuru⟧: to go against the intent
- {趣旨|しゅし}⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧: explanation of purpose

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧: purpose, objective (more concrete goals)
- ⟦{意図|いと}→意図：12625_ito⟧: intention (what someone means to do)
- ⟦{要旨|ようし}→要旨：04087_youshi⟧: gist, summary (main points of content)
- ⟦{主旨|しゅし}→主旨：28961_shushi⟧: same meaning, alternate kanji

REGISTER:
Used in formal speech, legal documents, business meetings, and official communications. In casual speech, ⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧ or ⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧ is more natural.
